method: Manual review of the exact frozen task, both outputs, both blind-order reasons, and supplied authority. A flag is confirmed only when the optimized output presents an unsupported fact, number, restriction, owner, capability name, or access condition as given/required.

Invented a mandatory named ui-remediation workflow/authority not supplied by the task.
Claimed access was limited to the message although read-only repository access was supplied.
Changed 'invoice arrives three weeks late' into 'three weeks after booking'.

Invented release-tier conventions and release-blocking policy not supplied by the task.
Invented that the requester/VP Strategy owns pricing approval.
